root_cause: LatestMarketSnapshotStore append skip compared observed_at, so every re-ingest of history that left the published points unchanged still appended a ~7.6 KB envelope; no compaction existed, journal reached 390702732 bytes / 50976 lines on hosted dev, above the 268435456-byte capture probe bound.

changes.skip: append is skipped when points, calendar evidence, market and close reconciliation are unchanged (observed_at no longer forces a line)
changes.compaction: LatestMarketSnapshotStore.compact(): last envelope per (symbol, dataset) with original bytes, tombstones that are the last word kept; fsynced temp file, projection digest verified before atomic os.replace, under LOCK_EX; writers re-open when the inode changed; runs at startup and after an append when journal bytes exceed compact_threshold_bytes (32 MiB)
changes.health: runtime._source_runtime_metrics -> /health.latest_market_snapshot_journal {journal_bytes, journal_lines, live_snapshot_count, last_compaction_at, capture_bound_bytes, warn_bytes (192 MiB, 75% of the bound), warning, last_compaction_error}

hosted_size_journal_probe.fixture: synthetic: 50976 lines, 1500 symbols, 60 points each, 681420074 bytes (larger than hosted 390702732)

memory_hosted_size.note: peak during the one-time startup compaction holds the projection twice (source and verification copy) plus a line-number map; steady state afterwards reads a 20 MB journal. Both far below the 2.9 GiB container limit.
